LEADERSHIP MESSAGE

Nurturing Champions from Idappadi to State Level

At Government Arts and Science College, Idappadi, the Department of Physical Education is committed to the holistic physical, mental, and ethical development of every young man and woman. Through this Smart Sports Management System, our athletes have instant digital access to collegiate competitions, team rosters, modern equipment stock, and practice schedules.

We actively support our players with university training camps, nutrition guidance, and competition exposure across Salem district, Periyar University, and Tamil Nadu State championships.
